parameters.question: Compare per-class precision, recall, and F1 for normal and arrhythmic ECG classifications within an absolute tolerance of 0.10, allowing row and column reordering.
Compare CNN performance metrics value by value, allowing row and column reordering. Accuracy values must agree within an absolute tolerance of 0.10.

Align the binary confusion matrices by true and predicted class meaning, allowing different class label names and column order. Normalize each cell count by the total test sample count in its matrix and require every corresponding cell proportion to differ by at most 0.10.
